en-US.name: Watchless
en-US.summary: Turns a video into a complete keyframe-led visual document with faithful transcript-based notes, exported as HTML, PDF or a shareable ZIP. Defaults to Tencent Cloud ASR, with separate account authorization and billing; configure Python, ffmpeg and other prerequisites separately.

zh-CN.name: Watchless
zh-CN.summary: 把视频转成以关键帧截图为主线的完整视觉文档：转写为事实来源、截图保留画面证据，输出 HTML/PDF/ZIP，读者无需再看原视频。默认使用腾讯云 ASR，需自行开通账号、授权与计费；Python、ffmpeg 等运行依赖另行配置。

requirements.value: The operator configures the Python environment, ffmpeg and other upstream video-processing dependencies.

Tencent Cloud ASR is the default cloud transcription provider; its account, credentials, service authorization and fees are separate. Other providers require explicit selection. Obtain permission before transferring non-public audio; use an explicitly requested local option or stop if authorization is unavailable.
